repos.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
repos.summary_zh: REA 是基于 MCP 协议的逆向工程智能体框架，支持原生二进制、JavaScript/Electron 应用、.NET 程序集及网页的多平台分析。通过对接 Hopper、Ghidra、IDA 等专业工具，让 AI 智能体在本地完成代码审查与行为逆向，输出带证据链的结论，适用于竞品分析与安全研究。
repos.summary_en: REA is an MCP-based reverse engineering agent framework supporting multi-platform analysis of native binaries, JavaScript/Electron apps, .NET assemblies, and websites. It connects to Hopper, Ghidra, and IDA for local code inspection and behavioral reverse engineering with evidence-backed conclusions, ideal for competitive analysis and security research.

repos.description: The open source coding agent.
repos.summary_zh: OpenCode是开源AI编程代理，提供终端与桌面双界面。支持多平台安装（macOS/Windows/Linux），集成多种包管理器。具备活跃社区与持续更新，为开发者提供智能编码辅助。
repos.summary_en: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent that delivers intelligent programming assistance through both terminal and desktop interfaces. It provides comprehensive multi-platform support for macOS, Windows, and Linux, with diverse installation options including npm, Homebrew, Scoop, Chocolatey, pacman, and direct shell scripts. The project maintains an active Discord community for real-time collaboration, offers beta desktop applications for enhanced user experience, ensures continuous updates, and respects XDG Base Directory Specification for flexible installation paths, providing developers with cutting-edge AI-powered coding capabilities across all development environments while maintaining high accessibility standards.

repos.description: A cross-platform desktop All-in-One assistant for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode,DeepSeek Harness and more. Only official website: ccswitch.io
repos.summary_zh: CC Switch是基于Tauri 2的跨平台桌面应用，为Claude Code、Codex和Gemini CLI提供统一管理平台。该工具解决开发者在多AI编程助手间切换的痛点，集成API中继服务配置，支持Windows、macOS和Linux系统。具备轻量级、高安全性特点，可显著提升AI辅助开发效率，实现一站式AI编码环境管理。
repos.summary_en: CC Switch is a cross-platform desktop application built with Tauri 2 that unifies management of AI coding assistants including Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. It eliminates workflow fragmentation by centralizing API relay configurations and model switching in a single interface. The lightweight, secure app runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux, streamlining AI-powered development and boosting developer productivity through consolidated tool management.

repos.description: An AI skill that provides design intelligence for building professional UI/UX across multiple platforms.
repos.summary_zh: UI UX Pro Max Skill 是一款AI驱动的设计智能工具，通过100条推理规则和67种UI样式库，实现专业级设计系统的自动生成。支持多平台框架，提供Python CLI命令行接口，可快速分析项目需求并输出定制化UI/UX方案，涵盖从布局模式到视觉风格的完整设计体系，显著提升设计效率与一致性。
repos.summary_en: UI UX Pro Max Skill is an AI-powered design intelligence tool that automatically generates professional design systems using 100 reasoning rules and 67 UI style libraries. Featuring a Python-based CLI, it analyzes project requirements and outputs customized UI/UX solutions—from hero-centric conversion patterns to soft UI evolution styles—enabling rapid creation of cohesive, production-ready design systems across web and mobile platforms while dramatically improving design efficiency, ensuring brand consistency, and reducing development iteration cycles.

repos.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
repos.summary_zh: Agent Skills 是为AI编程智能体打造的生产级工程技能库，将高级工程师的软件开发流程、质量门禁和最佳实践编码为标准化工作流。提供7个生命周期命令（/spec、/plan、/build等）和23个结构化技能，涵盖设计、开发到部署全流程。基于Markdown的提示工程实现自动化，支持Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini等多平台，确保AI代理在编码各阶段遵循一致的质量标准。
repos.summary_en: Agent Skills is a production-grade engineering skill pack for AI coding agents that codifies senior engineers' development workflows, quality gates, and best practices into standardized processes. It provides 7 lifecycle slash commands (/spec, /plan, /build, /test, /review, /code-simplify, /ship) and 23 structured skills covering the entire development lifecycle from design to production. Built on Markdown-based prompt engineering, it enables automated enforcement of code quality standards across platforms including Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, and GitHub Copilot.

repos.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
repos.summary_zh: Agent-Reach 为 AI 智能体提供命令行式全网接入，支持 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、B站、小红书等平台，自动处理认证与反爬，零 API 费用实现跨平台内容读取与搜索。
repos.summary_en: Agent-Reach is a CLI tool that equips AI agents with cross-platform internet access across Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, Bilibili, and XiaoHongShu. It automatically handles authentication, anti-bot measures, and data cleaning—zero API fees, one command to install.

repos.description: The 1st Collaborative AI Design Agent Workspace. Local-first and open source. Create motion, prototypes, websites, apps, dashboards, presentations, images, and videos with your team and AI agents. Share work, exchange feedback, and iterate together in one workspace.
repos.summary_zh: Open Design 是开源、本地优先的 Claude Design 替代品，支持 16+ AI 编码代理（Claude Code/Cursor/Gemini 等）。提供 31 种可组合技能和 72 个品牌级设计系统，可生成 Web/桌面/移动原型、幻灯片、图像和视频，支持 HTML/PDF/PPTX/MP4 导出。BYOK 模式确保数据自主，沙盒预览保障安全，是 Figma 的开源替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Open Design is an open-source, local-first alternative to Claude Design supporting 16+ AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, etc.). It offers 31 composable skills and 72 brand-grade design systems to generate web, desktop, and mobile prototypes, slides, images, and videos. Features include sandboxed preview, HTML/PDF/PPTX/MP4 export, and BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) model for data sovereignty. A viable open-source replacement for Figma with multi-agent flexibility.

repos.description: Fast, accurate & comprehensive text measurement & layout
repos.summary_zh: Pretext 是一个纯 TypeScript 文本测量与布局引擎，通过绕过 DOM 测量彻底避免浏览器重排。它预计算文本分段和宽度，后续布局纯算术运算，支持多语言、RTL 和 emoji。适用于虚拟化列表、自定义布局、防止布局偏移及 AI 开发时的文本溢出验证，可渲染至 DOM/Canvas/SVG/SSR 多种环境。
repos.summary_en: Pretext is a pure TypeScript text measurement and layout engine that eliminates expensive browser reflow by bypassing DOM measurements entirely. It precomputes text segmentation and character widths, then performs subsequent layout through pure arithmetic operations, supporting multilingual text, RTL languages, and emojis. Perfect for virtualization, custom masonry layouts, preventing layout shift, and AI-assisted development text overflow checks. Renders seamlessly to DOM, Canvas, SVG, and server-side environments.

repos.description: An open-source coding agent for your terminal, written in Rust. It works with any model, can split one task across several agents, and every line of it is yours to read.
repos.summary_zh: Codewhale 是一款开源终端 AI 编程智能体，基于 Rust 构建，支持任意大模型（云端或本地）。它能自主读取项目、编辑文件、执行命令并自我校验，提供交互式 TUI、无头模式及 PR 审查等多种运行方式，适用于自动化代码修复与开发者效率提升。
repos.summary_en: Codewhale is an open-source terminal-based AI coding agent built in Rust, supporting any LLM provider (hosted or local). It autonomously reads projects, edits files, runs commands, and self-verifies results. Offers interactive TUI, headless CI mode, and PR review for developer productivity.

repos.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.
repos.summary_zh: Magpie 是跨平台本地网关，统一管理 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码智能体的模型配置。支持多供应商切换与配额耗尽自动故障转移，提供菜单栏、TUI、Web UI 及 CLI 界面，实现任意智能体与任意模型的灵活组合。
repos.summary_en: Magpie is a cross-platform local gateway that centralizes model configuration for multiple AI coding agents including Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. It supports multi-provider switching, automatic failover when quotas are exhausted, and provides menu bar, TUI, Web UI, and CLI interfaces. Developers can flexibly pair any agent with any model across macOS, Windows, Linux, Docker, and Termux environments. One unified app manages all agent configs, provider keys, and routing rules, ensuring seamless model switching without manual intervention or downtime.

repos.description: Your Personal AI Assistant; easy to install, deploy on your own machine or on the cloud; supports multiple chat apps with easily extensible capabilities.
repos.summary_zh: QwenPaw是自主可控的个人AI助手，支持本地或云端部署确保数据隐私。提供日程管理、PDF/Office文档处理、新闻摘要等内置技能，支持自定义扩展。具备多智能体协作能力，可创建独立代理处理不同任务。跨平台连接多种聊天应用，技能决定功能边界，无供应商锁定风险。
repos.summary_en: QwenPaw is a personal AI assistant under your control, deployable locally or in the cloud to ensure data privacy. It features built-in skills including scheduling, PDF/Office document processing, and news digests, with support for custom extensions. Enables multi-agent collaboration by creating independent agents for different tasks. Connects across multiple chat platforms with extensible capabilities and no vendor lock-in.

repos.description: Create polished demo videos without editing skills. Mac/Windows/Linux
repos.summary_zh: Recordly 是一款开源跨平台的屏幕录制与编辑工具，专为产品演示、教程视频等场景设计。其核心亮点在于自动化后期处理：智能缩放、光标美化、动态摄像头叠加和样式化边框，无需专业剪辑即可生成 polished 视频。采用原生捕获技术（ScreenCaptureKit/WGC）保证性能，支持扩展插件，实现录制到编辑的一体化工作流。
repos.summary_en: Recordly is an open-source, cross-platform screen recorder and editor designed for product demos, tutorials, and walkthroughs. It automates post-production with AI-powered zoom suggestions, cursor polish, dynamic webcam overlays, and styled frames—eliminating manual editing. Built on native capture backends (ScreenCaptureKit/WGC) for performance, it features an extensible plugin system and seamless record-to-edit workflow.

repos.description: Uncensored Open-source alternative to AI video platforms — Free AI image & video generation studio with 800+ models (Flux, Midjourney, Kling, Sora, Veo). No content filters. Self-hosted, MIT licensed.
repos.summary_zh: 开源AI媒体生成工作室，集成200+先进模型（Flux、Sora、Kling等），提供无过滤的图像视频创作环境。支持自托管与跨平台桌面应用，通过AI编码代理实现提示→生成→编辑→合成的全流程自动化，是商业AI平台的开源替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Open-source AI media generation studio integrating 200+ state-of-the-art models (Flux, Sora, Kling) for unfiltered image/video creation. Features self-hosting, cross-platform desktop apps, and AI agent automation for end-to-end media pipeline orchestration. MIT-licensed alternative to commercial platforms.

repos.description: Free, local plugin that keeps tool output out of your coding agent's context window. Sandbox and SQLite FTS5 search, 99% fewer bytes in context. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OMP, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI and 4 more agents. Zero telemetry.
repos.summary_zh: Context Mode 是面向 AI 编码代理的上下文优化工具。作为 MCP 服务器，它通过沙箱工具输出实现 98% 上下文减少，支持 15 个平台集成。利用 SQLite 追踪会话并以 FTS5/BM25 检索关键信息，倡导代码执行范式处理数据。集成 Claude、Cursor 等 IDE，已获微软、谷歌团队采用。
repos.summary_en: Context Mode optimizes context windows for AI coding agents as an MCP server. It sandboxes tool outputs for 98% reduction, e.g., 315KB to 5.4KB. SQLite with FTS5 and BM25 ensures session continuity by indexing and retrieving relevant events on compaction. 'Think in code' via ctx_* tools lets agents script data processing instead of loading raw data. Supports 15 platforms like Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code Copilot via plugins and hooks. Adopted by Microsoft, Google, Meta teams.

repos.description: A self-hostable bookmark-everything app (links, notes and images) with AI-based automatic tagging and full text search
repos.summary_zh: Karakeep 是一款自托管的书签管理工具，支持链接、笔记、图片和 PDF 的收藏。核心亮点包括 AI 自动标签与摘要（支持 ChatGPT 和本地 Ollama 模型）、全文搜索、OCR 文字识别，以及完整的网页与视频归档功能。提供浏览器插件、iOS/Android 应用，并可通过 RSS 自动抓取。基于 NextJS 和 tRPC 构建，注重隐私与数据自主，适合数字资料囤积者。
repos.summary_en: Karakeep is a self-hostable bookmark manager designed for digital hoarders to collect links, notes, images, and PDFs. It leverages AI for automatic tagging and summarization, supporting both ChatGPT and local Ollama models. The app provides full-text search, OCR for image text extraction, and complete web/video archiving using monolith and yt-dlp. Available on web, mobile (iOS/Android), and browsers via extensions, it includes RSS auto-hoarding, REST API, and SSO. Built with NextJS, Drizzle ORM, and tRPC, it emphasizes privacy and data sovereignty.

repos.description: A modern ebook manager and reader with sync and backup capacities for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS and Web
repos.summary_zh: Koodo Reader 是一款开源的跨平台电子书阅读管理工具，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS 及 Web 全平台。核心亮点包括：支持 EPUB、PDF、MOBI 等 15+ 格式，集成 OneDrive、Google Drive 等 10+ 云存储实现数据同步，内置 AI 词典翻译与文本朗读功能，提供丰富的阅读自定义选项，是个人数字阅读管理的理想解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Koodo Reader is an open-source, cross-platform ebook management and reading application supporting Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and Web. Key features include: compatibility with 15+ formats including EPUB, PDF, and MOBI; seamless synchronization via 10+ cloud services like OneDrive and Google Drive; integrated AI-powered dictionary, translation and text-to-speech; extensive customization for fonts, themes and layouts. It provides a comprehensive solution for personal digital reading management across all devices.

repos.description: Readest is a modern, feature-rich ebook reader designed for avid readers offering seamless cross-platform access, powerful tools, and an intuitive interface to elevate your reading experience.
repos.summary_zh: Readest 是一款基于 Next.js 16 和 Tauri v2 构建的开源电子书阅读器，覆盖桌面、移动及 Web 全平台。支持 EPUB/MOBI/AZW3 等主流格式，提供分屏并行阅读、代码语法高亮、全文检索与智能笔记等深度功能，专为追求沉浸式体验的深度阅读者打造。
repos.summary_en: Readest is a modern, open-source ebook reader engineered for immersive reading experiences. Leveraging Next.js 16 and Tauri v2, it delivers native performance across macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, iOS, and web platforms. Supporting EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, CBZ, TXT, and experimental PDF formats, it features split-screen parallel reading, code syntax highlighting, full-text search, dictionary lookup, and comprehensive annotation tools. Built as a sophisticated rewrite of Foliate, Readest combines powerful library management with customizable reading settings to serve avid readers and technical professionals.

repos.description: The official source code repository for the calibre ebook manager
repos.summary_zh: calibre 是一款功能全面的电子书管理工具，支持主流格式查看、转换、编辑与编目。其核心优势在于强大的格式转换引擎、跨平台兼容性（Linux/Windows/macOS）、设备同步能力，以及自动抓取元数据和将新闻转换为电子书的功能，是构建个人数字图书馆的理想解决方案。
repos.summary_en: calibre is a comprehensive e-book management suite offering viewing, conversion, editing, and cataloging across major formats. Key strengths include a powerful conversion engine, cross-platform support (Linux/Windows/macOS), device synchronization, automated metadata fetching, and news-to-ebook conversion capabilities, making it ideal for personal digital library management.

repos.description: A maintained, feature-rich and performance oriented, neofetch like system information tool.
repos.summary_zh: Fastfetch 是一款用 C 语言编写的高性能系统信息展示工具，作为 neofetch 的现代替代品，专注于性能与可定制性。它支持 Linux、macOS、Windows、Android 等十余种操作系统，提供美观的视觉输出与丰富的配置选项。适用于开发者、系统管理员在终端快速获取并展示系统详情，支持多种包管理器一键安装，社区活跃且持续维护更新。
repos.summary_en: Fastfetch is a high-performance system information tool written in C, designed as a modern, maintained alternative to neofetch with emphasis on performance and customizability. It supports over 10 operating systems including Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, and various BSD variants, delivering visually appealing output with extensive configuration options. Ideal for developers and sysadmins to display system details in terminals, it offers easy installation via major package managers and maintains active community development with regular updates.

repos.description: 1,324-exercise fitness dataset — animation GIFs, 180×180 thumbnails, muscle-group & equipment data, and step-by-step instructions in 6 languages. The exercise data layer behind the LogPress app.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供1,324个健身动作的综合数据集，每个动作包含动画GIF、180×180缩略图、身体部位/器械/目标肌肉/肌群元数据，以及9种语言的分步指导说明。作为LogPress AI健身追踪应用的底层数据，支持健身应用开发、运动识别推荐的机器学习项目、健康研究及教育原型。亮点包括结构化JSON文件与验证模式、纯客户端交互浏览器（搜索筛选多语言详情）、开发者工具（多数据库SQL生成、API示例及LLM后端提示），媒体按Gym visual许可使用。
repos.summary_en: This repository delivers a ready-to-use dataset of 1,324 fitness exercises, each with animated GIFs, 180×180 thumbnails, metadata on body parts, equipment, targets and muscle groups, plus step-by-step instructions in 9 languages. It powers the LogPress AI-assisted workout tracker and supports fitness app development, ML exercise recognition/recommendation, health research, and education. Highlights include validated JSON with schema, client-side interactive browser with search/filters/multilingual details, and developer tools offering DB SQL generators, API examples across languages, and LLM prompts for backend generation. Media licensed from Gym visual.

repos.description: Open-source gym & body-weight tracker, now in the App Store (iPhone + Apple Watch) and as an Android APK. Plan routines, log workouts, see which muscles are trained, import from Strong/Hevy/FitNotes. Self-host it or use it on the phone alone.
repos.summary_zh: openGym 是一款自托管健身与体重追踪应用，支持训练计划、组数记录、肌肉疲劳分析、跨设备同步与 Passkey 登录。数据完全由用户掌控，支持从 FitNotes/Strong/Hevy 导入，提供 Android APK 与 Web 端，是隐私优先的开源健身管理方案。
repos.summary_en: openGym is a self-hosted gym and body-weight tracker that lets you plan weekly routines, log every set including supersets, warm-ups, and cardio, and visualize which muscles are trained, fatigued, or detrained. It supports cross-device sync, passkey login, and data import from FitNotes, Strong, and Hevy. Your data stays on your own server, giving you full ownership and privacy. Available as a web app and Android APK, it's a privacy-first, open-source alternative to commercial fitness subscriptions, with stats dashboards featuring heatmaps, charts, and personal records.

repos.description: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop application that turns your documents into an organized, interlinked knowledge base — automatically. Instead of traditional RAG (retrieve-and-answer from scratch every time), the LLM incrementally builds and maintains a persistent wiki from your sources。
repos.summary_zh: LLM Wiki 是一款跨平台桌面应用，采用增量编译模式构建自组织知识库，颠覆传统RAG每次查询重检索的机制。核心亮点包括：双阶段思维链文档摄入、多模态图像理解、四信号知识图谱、Louvain社区发现，以及本地API支持AI智能体调用。实现文档自动结构化为可追溯、可探索的互联知识网络。
repos.summary_en: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop app that incrementally builds a persistent, self-organizing knowledge base from documents—compiling knowledge once instead of re-deriving on every query like traditional RAG. Key features include two-step Chain-of-Thought ingestion, multimodal image understanding, 4-signal knowledge graph, Louvain community detection, and local API for AI agent integration. Automatically transforms documents into interconnected, explorable knowledge networks with source traceability.

repos.description: 简简单单的看直播
repos.summary_zh: Simple Live 是基于 Flutter 3.38 和 Dart 开发的跨平台直播聚合应用，支持虎牙、斗鱼、B站、抖音四大平台。项目采用 core+app+tv 模块化架构，覆盖 Android/iOS/Windows/macOS/Linux/TV 全终端，集成弹幕系统。作为开源学习项目，展示直播协议解析与 Flutter 全平台开发实践。
repos.summary_en: Simple Live is a cross-platform live streaming aggregation application developed with Flutter 3.38 and Dart language. It integrates mainstream platforms including Huya, Douyu, Bilibili, and TikTok, providing a unified viewing experience. The project adopts a modular architecture with separate core library, console, mobile app, and TV client, supporting Android, iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android TV. Key features include real-time danmaku display and multi-platform synchronization. As an educational open-source project, it showcases practical implementations of live streaming protocol parsing and Flutter's full-platform development capabilities.

repos.description: Structured Outputs
repos.summary_zh: Outlines 是一款专为 LLM 提供结构化输出的 Python 库。它在生成阶段直接施加约束，确保输出严格符合 Pydantic 模型、枚举或特定类型，无需后处理解析。兼容 OpenAI、Ollama、vLLM 等任意模型，集成简便且提供商无关。核心亮点包括类型系统驱动的约束生成、跨模型一致性及 100% 有效输出保障。适用于客户支持分类、电商产品归类、事件解析、函数调用等生产场景，被 NVIDIA、Hugging Face 等采用，提升 AI 应用可靠性与自动化水平。
repos.summary_en: Outlines is a Python library for generating structured outputs from LLMs by enforcing constraints during generation. It supports any model provider including OpenAI, Ollama, vLLM, and Transformers, with simple integration via Pydantic models, literals, or enums. This ensures 100% valid outputs like JSON without post-processing. Key features include provider independence, type-system philosophy mirroring Python, and guaranteed compliance. Ideal for customer support triage, e-commerce categorization, event parsing, and function calling. Trusted by NVIDIA, Cohere, and Hugging Face for reliable production AI systems.

repos.description: AI that sees your screen, listens to your conversations and tells you what to do
repos.summary_zh: Omi是开源的AI第二大脑，实时捕捉屏幕与对话内容，自动生成转录、摘要及行动项。跨平台支持macOS、iOS、Android及可穿戴设备，采用Swift/Rust/Flutter技术栈，集成Deepgram语音识别与LLM大模型，构建具备长期记忆的智能助手，已获30万+专业人士信赖。
repos.summary_en: Omi is an open-source AI second brain that captures screen content and conversations in real-time, automatically generating transcripts, summaries, and action items. Built with Swift/Rust/Flutter for cross-platform support across desktop, mobile, and wearables, it integrates Deepgram speech recognition and LLMs to create a memory-capable AI assistant. The system processes audio via GPU-accelerated VAD and diarization, storing data in Firestore with Redis caching. Trusted by 300,000+ professionals, it offers a chat interface that remembers all user interactions.

repos.description: A small, fast container runtime for macOS, Windows and Linux with free Ngrok alternative
repos.summary_zh: Kiri 是一款用 Rust 编写的轻量级容器运行时，兼容 Docker CLI、Compose 与 buildx，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。它通过单个小型 Linux 虚拟机运行容器，启动速度比 Docker Desktop 快约 80 倍，内存占用仅约 15 MB，并内置本地域名、HTTPS 证书、Kubernetes 集群及多语言界面，是 Docker Desktop 和 OrbStack 的高效替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Kiri is a lightweight container runtime written in Rust, compatible with Docker CLI, Compose, and buildx on macOS, Windows, and Linux. It runs containers in a single small Linux VM, starting about 80x faster than Docker Desktop with ~15 MB memory footprint. It offers local domains, HTTPS certificates, a one-command Kubernetes cluster, and a 38-language UI, serving as a fast alternative to Docker Desktop and OrbStack.

repos.description: Claude-first paid-media operations skill for Claude Code across 12 ad platforms (Google, Meta, YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, Reddit, Pinterest, Snapchat, X): source-grounded audits, deterministic findings and evidence coverage, versioned JSON reports, and capability-gated account changes.
repos.summary_zh: 为Claude Code设计的付费广告审计AI技能，覆盖Google、Meta等8大平台，通过250+检查项在10-15分钟内完成原需4-6小时的人工审计。采用加权评分和并行代理技术，提供优先级行动方案与AI创意生成，支持跨平台部署，适用于PPC代理机构、企业内部营销团队及自由顾问。
repos.summary_en: An AI skill for Claude Code that automates paid advertising audits across 8 platforms including Google and Meta. It performs 250+ checks in 10-15 minutes, replacing 4-6 hours of manual work. Features weighted scoring, parallel agents, prioritized action plans, and AI creative generation. Cross-platform compatible for PPC agencies, in-house marketers, and freelance consultants.

repos.description: Technitium DNS Server
repos.summary_zh: Technitium DNS Server 是开源跨平台权威/递归DNS服务器，支持自托管以提升隐私与安全。开箱即用，提供Web控制台，可网络级拦截广告与恶意软件，支持DoT/DoH/DoQ加密协议、集群管理、LDAP/OIDC认证及高性能异步IO。适用于家庭与企业网络，内置缓存、DNSSEC与应用扩展框架，显著提升解析速度与控制力。
repos.summary_en: Technitium DNS Server is an open-source cross-platform authoritative and recursive DNS server for self-hosting with strong privacy and security focus. It works out-of-the-box with a web console, enables network-wide ad/malware blocking, supports DoT/DoH/DoQ encrypted protocols, clustering, LDAP/OIDC auth, and high-performance async I/O. Ideal for home and enterprise networks, featuring advanced caching, DNSSEC, and an apps framework for enhanced control and speed.

repos.description: Generate audiobooks from e-books
repos.summary_zh: audiblez 利用 Kokoro-82M 高质量语音合成模型，将 EPUB 电子书自动转换为 M4B 有声书。支持中英法等9种语言，提供命令行与图形界面，跨平台运行。GPU 加速下5分钟完成《动物农场》转换，是个人制作无障碍阅读内容的理想工具。
repos.summary_en: Audiblez converts EPUB e-books to M4B audiobooks using Kokoro-82M TTS model. Supporting 9 languages including Chinese and English, it offers CLI/GUI interfaces with cross-platform compatibility. With GPU acceleration, it processes 160K characters in 5 minutes, ideal for creating accessible content.

repos.description: The world's first open-source AI-native vector design tool and the first to feature concurrent Agent Teams. Design-as-Code. Turn prompts into UI directly on the live canvas. A modern alternative to Pencil.
repos.summary_zh: 全球首个开源AI原生矢量设计工具，首创并发Agent Teams协同架构，支持多模型智能调度与MCP服务。通过自然语言提示实时流式生成UI，提供Design-as-Code的JSON格式，实现跨平台AI驱动的设计到代码全流程。
repos.summary_en: The world's first open-source AI-native vector design tool featuring concurrent Agent Teams for parallel UI generation. Transforms natural language prompts into live canvas designs with streaming animation, offering Design-as-Code JSON format and MCP server integration for cross-platform AI-driven design-to-code workflows.

repos.description: Simple Proxy Client to force proxy to any Windows/MacOS/Linux Application TCP and UDP traffic
repos.summary_zh: ProxyBridge是轻量开源跨平台代理客户端（Proxifier替代品），支持Windows、macOS、Linux。它在系统层透明拦截指定进程的TCP/UDP流量，通过SOCKS5或HTTP代理路由、阻止或放行，无需修改应用配置，兼容无代理感知程序，适用于安全测试、流量分析及协议调试。
repos.summary_en: ProxyBridge is a lightweight open-source cross-platform proxy client (Proxifier alternative) for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It transparently redirects TCP/UDP traffic from specific processes through SOCKS5 or HTTP proxies at the system level, supporting per-app routing, blocking, or allowing. Compatible with proxy-unaware apps without configuration changes, ideal for security testing and traffic analysis.

repos.description: Easy and blazing-fast book searcher, create and search your private library.
repos.summary_zh: 极速图书搜索引擎，支持创建私有书库。一分钟索引超1000万图书元数据，检索响应仅30微秒。提供跨平台桌面应用、命令行工具及Web API，支持Docker、Vercel/Netlify部署，可按字段精准搜索。
repos.summary_en: Ultra-fast book search engine for private libraries. Indexes 10M+ books/min, searches in 30µs. Cross-platform desktop, CLI, Web API. Docker/Vercel support.

repos.description: Open-source, desktop-grade AI agent that gets real work done — data analysis, slides, docs, video & web research. Built on OpenClaw; runs tools on your real desktop and takes commands from your phone via WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk & Telegram.
repos.summary_zh: 网易有道推出的LobsterAI是一款24/7全场景AI个人助理，基于Electron+React构建跨平台桌面应用。核心采用Cowork模式，支持本地或Alpine沙盒环境执行任务，内置Office文档生成、Playwright自动化、Remotion视频生成等技能。通过Telegram/Discord/DingTalk/Feishu实现移动端远程控制，具备持久化记忆与权限审批机制，覆盖数据分析、PPT制作、邮件处理等办公场景。
repos.summary_en: LobsterAI by NetEase Youdao is a 24/7 all-scenario AI personal assistant built on Electron+React. Its core Cowork mode executes tasks in local or Alpine sandbox environments, featuring built-in skills like Office document generation, Playwright automation, and Remotion video creation. It enables remote control via IM platforms (Telegram/Discord/DingTalk/Feishu), persistent memory, permission gating, and covers productivity scenarios including data analysis, presentation creation, and email management.

repos.description: 高颜值第三方 B 站 React Native 客户端
repos.summary_zh: JKVideo 是一款基于 React Native 和 Expo 构建的高颜值第三方 B 站客户端，支持 Android、iOS 和 Web 三端。核心亮点包括完整的 DASH 视频播放系统（4K HDR）、实时弹幕同步、纯 TypeScript 实现的 WBI 签名算法，以及 Zustand 状态管理。提供扫码登录、下载管理和局域网分享功能，是跨平台视频应用开发的优秀实践。
repos.summary_en: JKVideo is a high-quality third-party Bilibili client built with React Native and Expo, supporting Android, iOS, and Web platforms. Key features include complete DASH video playback (4K HDR), real-time danmaku synchronization, pure TypeScript WBI signing algorithm, and Zustand state management. It offers QR code login, download management, and LAN sharing capabilities, serving as an excellent example of cross-platform video application development.

repos.description: AI You Control: Choose your models. Own your data. Eliminate vendor lock-in.
repos.summary_zh: Thunderbolt 是 Mozilla 开源的跨平台 AI 客户端，主打'AI You Control'理念。支持本地部署，兼容 Ollama、llama.cpp 等本地推理引擎及 OpenAI 兼容 API，彻底摆脱供应商锁定。提供桌面、移动端全覆盖，面向企业客户，支持私有化部署，强调数据主权与安全可控，目前处于安全审计阶段，即将企业就绪。
repos.summary_en: Thunderbolt is Mozilla's open-source, cross-platform AI client championing 'AI You Control' with full vendor lock-in elimination. It supports local deployment, integrates with Ollama, llama.cpp and OpenAI-compatible APIs, ensuring data ownership. Available across desktop and mobile platforms, it targets enterprise on-premise deployment with enhanced security and privacy, currently undergoing security audit for production readiness.

repos.description: On-device subtitle generation that connects directly to DaVinci Resolve, Premiere, and After Effects.
repos.summary_zh: AutoSubs 是一款基于 Tauri 框架的跨平台 AI 字幕生成工具，本地运行 Whisper 等模型实现高精度语音转录。支持说话人分离、多语言翻译，可导出 SRT 或直接导入 DaVinci Resolve 进行高级样式定制。无需云端订阅，保障数据隐私，为视频创作者提供高效、可定制的自动化字幕解决方案。
repos.summary_en: AutoSubs is a cross-platform desktop application that generates AI-powered subtitles locally on user devices without cloud dependencies. Built on Tauri framework with React frontend and Rust backend, it leverages state-of-the-art models including Whisper, Parakeet and Pyannote for accurate transcription, speaker diarization and translation. The tool offers one-click export to SRT or direct integration with DaVinci Resolve, featuring per-speaker styling and real-time editing capabilities. Designed for video creators and post-production professionals, it delivers privacy-preserving, efficient subtitle workflows with full customization options.

repos.description: Collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace: aggregate sessions from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Grok Build, etc. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.
repos.summary_zh: Codeg 是多智能体 AI 编程协作工作区，统一聚合 Claude Code、Codex、Grok Build 等十余种 AI 编码代理，支持跨代理会话迁移与 @ 委派协作，提供桌面端、自托管服务器、Docker 及移动端全平台部署，让多个 AI 代理在同一结构化界面中协同完成开发任务。
repos.summary_en: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace that unifies 15+ AI coding agents—Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, OpenCode, and more—into a single structured conversation interface with live diffs and project file browsing. It supports cross-agent session import, search, and transfer, plus @-delegation for inter-agent task collaboration in isolated worktrees. Deployable as a desktop app, self-hosted server, Docker container, or mobile apps for iOS and Android, with integrations for Telegram, Lark, and WeChat for remote access.

repos.description: 京东抢购自动下单助手，GUI 支持 Windows 和 macOS
repos.summary_zh: 京东小猪手是Python开发的跨平台自动抢购助手，核心功能包括7x24小时库存监听、自动下单及微信通知。支持扫码登录与预售定金模式，提供Windows/macOS图形界面，简化配置流程。采用SKU/AreaID精准定位商品与配送区域，适用于秒杀、缺货商品监控等场景，提升抢购成功率。
repos.summary_en: JdBuyer is a Python-based cross-platform automation assistant for JD.com flash sales. It provides 24/7 stock monitoring, automatic order placement, and WeChat notifications. The tool features QR code login, GUI support for Windows/macOS, and handles pre-sale deposits. Users configure SKU/AreaID for precise targeting, making it effective for seckill events and out-of-stock tracking, giving regular buyers equal opportunity against automated scalpers.

repos.description: Advanced Privacy Browser Core with Unified Fingerprint Defense: Cloudflare, Akamai, Kasada, Shape, DataDome, PerimeterX, hCaptcha, FunCaptcha, Imperva, reCAPTCHA, ThreatMetrix, Adscore
repos.summary_zh: BotBrowser是一款专注于反浏览器指纹追踪的隐私浏览器核心。基于最新Chromium构建，通过统一指纹防御技术，在Windows、macOS、Linux等跨平台环境下保持完全一致的指纹特征，有效对抗Cloudflare、Akamai、Kasada等31+种高级追踪检测机制。支持Playwright/Puppeteer集成，提供QUIC/STUN全代理网络栈和毫秒级独立指纹切换，性能损耗低于1%。适用于隐私研究、反欺诈测试和自动化工具开发。
repos.summary_en: BotBrowser is a privacy-first browser core engineered to neutralize browser fingerprinting across platforms. Built on the latest Chromium, it maintains identical fingerprint signatures on Windows, macOS, and Linux, defeating over 31 tracking systems including Cloudflare, Akamai, and Kasada. Key features include Playwright/Puppeteer integration with CDP leak blocking, full QUIC/STUN proxy tunneling, per-context fingerprint isolation with millisecond switching, and benchmark-proven performance parity with Chrome. Designed for privacy research and authorized defensive benchmarking.

repos.description: Blender's GPU Accelerated UI, Decoupled from it's original codebase. Supports Rust, Python, JS, Lua, C & C++. Twice as good as GPUI
repos.summary_zh: BUI 将 Blender 历经数十年优化的 GPU 加速 GUI 解耦为独立库，支持 Python、Rust、JavaScript (React/Svelte)、C、C++ 及 Dear ImGui 等多种语言和框架。具备高能效、低内存占用与极速渲染特性，跨 Windows/Linux/macOS 平台，适合构建高性能桌面应用界面。
repos.summary_en: BUI decouples Blender's decades-optimized GPU-accelerated GUI into a standalone library, supporting Python, Rust, JavaScript (React/Svelte), C, C++, and Dear ImGui. It delivers high energy efficiency, low memory footprint, and blazing-fast rendering across Windows, Linux, and macOS, ideal for building high-performance desktop UIs.

repos.description: Translate full-length books and documents with Ollama, OpenAI-compatible, Gemini, Mistral, DeepSeek, Poe or OpenRouter. Preserves formatting. Resumes where you left off. No file size limits.
repos.summary_zh: 该桌面应用利用Ollama、OpenAI、Gemini等LLM翻译书籍、字幕和文档，支持EPUB、SRT、DOCX、TXT格式。智能分块处理任意长度文件，严格保留格式、样式与结构，支持断点续传。提供本地隐私部署与云端API选项，跨平台易用，适合长篇内容多语言处理与本地化场景。
repos.summary_en: TranslateBooksWithLLMs is a cross-platform desktop app that leverages LLMs like local Ollama, OpenAI, Gemini and others to translate full-length books, subtitles and documents. It supports EPUB, SRT, DOCX and TXT formats with perfect preservation of structure and styling, uses intelligent chunking for unlimited file sizes while maintaining context, and features automatic checkpoints for resuming translations. Offers both offline local processing and cloud APIs via a simple local web interface.

repos.description: aimili-vpngate是一个借助vpngate.net让Linux用干净ip出站的代理工具。
repos.summary_zh: aimili-vpngate是一款面向Linux VPS的VPNGate节点管理与代理网关工具，基于Python标准库实现节点自动获取、检测与切换，提供HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5多协议代理及Web管理后台，支持一键安装与Docker部署，适用于需要干净IP出站的跨境网络场景。
repos.summary_en: aimili-vpngate is a VPNGate node management and proxy gateway for Linux VPS, built with Python standard library. It offers HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5 proxy, node auto-detection and switching, a web dashboard, one-click install, and Docker deployment for clean IP outbound use cases.

repos.description: Warp+Psiphon, an anti censorship utility for iran
repos.summary_zh: Warp-Plus是基于Cloudflare Warp的开源实现，深度集成Psiphon链式代理，专为伊朗等高审查环境打造的抗审查工具。支持Warp-in-Warp双层隧道改变虚拟NAT位置、SOCKS5代理、端点扫描与跨平台部署（含Termux），提供快速、安全且灵活的翻墙VPN解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Warp-Plus is an open-source Cloudflare Warp implementation enhanced with Psiphon chaining for robust censorship circumvention in restrictive regions like Iran. It features Warp-in-Warp dual tunneling to shift virtual NAT locations, SOCKS5 proxy support, endpoint scanning, and cross-platform compatibility including Termux, delivering a fast, secure VPN solution for unrestricted internet access.

repos.description: Run OpenClaw on Android with a single command — no proot, no Linux
repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过仅安装glibc动态链接器（ld.so）替代传统proot-distro方案，实现OpenClaw在Android/Termux上的一键部署，存储开销从1-2GB降至约200MB，并提供独立APK应用，无需完整Linux发行版即可运行Node.js应用。
repos.summary_en: Runs OpenClaw on Android/Termux using only glibc ld.so, eliminating proot-distro. Cuts storage from 1-2GB to ~200MB with one-command setup and a standalone APK app.

repos.description: Run OpenClaw AI Gateway on Android — standalone Flutter app with built-in terminal, web dashboard, and one-tap setup. Also available as a Termux CLI package.
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw 将 OpenClaw AI 网关移植到 Android 平台，提供免 root 的 Flutter 独立应用和 Termux CLI 两种模式。通过 proot 技术自动构建 Ubuntu 环境并安装 Node.js 22 和 OpenClaw，实现一键部署。应用内置终端模拟器、Web 管理面板、实时日志查看和网关启停控制，支持 API 密钥配置和后台常驻服务。可选安装 Go 和 Homebrew 开发工具，让 Android 设备成为便携的 AI 网关节点。
repos.summary_en: OpenClaw brings the OpenClaw AI Gateway to Android via a standalone Flutter app and Termux CLI package. It uses proot to automatically set up an Ubuntu environment with Node.js 22 and OpenClaw, requiring no root access. The app features a built-in terminal emulator, embedded web dashboard, real-time log viewer, and gateway controls. It supports one-tap deployment, API key configuration, background foreground service, and optional installation of Go and Homebrew tools, turning Android devices into portable AI gateway nodes.

repos.description: Secure MCP runtime for AI agents to operate local machines, servers, and containers with multi-device orchestration.
repos.summary_zh: AgentDock 为 AI 智能体提供安全 MCP 运行时，支持多设备编排与跨平台控制。通过统一 MCP 接口实现文件、命令、Git、浏览器自动化等操作，兼容 ChatGPT、Claude 等客户端。支持多实例连接同一对话协调跨设备工作，具备明确权限边界、任务可恢复性和技能扩展能力，适用于开发部署、运维管理和真实环境自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: AgentDock is a secure MCP runtime empowering AI agents with controlled access to local machines, servers, and containers via multi-device orchestration. It unifies file operations, command execution, Git, browser automation, and extensible Skills into an MCP interface compatible with clients like ChatGPT and Claude. Multiple instances connect to one conversation for cross-device coordination, featuring explicit permissions, recoverable tasks, and structured results. Ideal for development, deployment, and operations beyond coding quotas across platforms.

repos.description: 微信读书 koreader 插件，在 koreader 里阅读微信读书里的书籍、公众号文章，支持阅读进度同步，阅读时长上报和统计，本地书籍支持获取微信读书划线和想法内容，支持Kindle、Kobo等所有能安装 koreader 的设备。
repos.summary_zh: 微信读书 KOReader 插件，可在 Kindle、Kobo 等设备上阅读微信读书书籍与公众号文章，支持进度同步、时长统计、划线想法获取及章节预下载，打通封闭系统与微信读书生态。
repos.summary_en: KOReader plugin for WeRead on Kindle/Kobo: progress sync, reading stats, highlights, pre-download.

repos.description: High-performance native SSH client in Rust, GPU-rendered with GPUI: host manager, terminal, WinSCP-style SFTP and port forwarding. Rust 编写、GPU 渲染的原生 SSH 客户端。
repos.summary_zh: ShellRS 是一款 Rust 编写的高性能跨平台原生 SSH 客户端，基于 GPUI 实现 GPU 渲染界面。集成 Xshell 风格主机管理、WinSCP 风格 SFTP 文件传输及端口转发，支持多级跳板与代理连接，无 Electron 依赖，并提供 CLI 供 AI 智能体调用。
repos.summary_en: ShellRS is a high-performance, cross-platform native SSH client written in Rust, featuring GPU-accelerated rendering powered by the GPUI framework from the Zed editor. It unifies Xshell-style host management, tabbed terminals, WinSCP-style dual-pane SFTP file transfer, and SSH port forwarding into a single integrated window. The client supports multi-level jump hosts, HTTP and SOCKS5 proxy connections, and stores credentials securely in the system keychain. With no Electron or JVM dependencies, it delivers native performance. A built-in CLI tool also enables AI agents like Claude Code to execute commands and transfer files on saved hosts.

repos.description: 基于 11 个内容洞见维度的自媒体创作 Skill，适用于各种智能体  给它一个主题，它给你一篇完整的文章、5 个备选标题、以及每张配图的生成 prompt。
repos.summary_zh: 这个仓库提供了一个基于11个内容洞见维度的AI智能体写作技能，能够根据主题自动生成可直接发布的完整文章、5个备选标题及配图prompt。支持微信公众号、小红书、抖音多平台适配，通过系统性思考框架提升内容深度与传播力，输出结构化Markdown，显著提高创作效率与质量。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers a viral writing skill for AI agents based on 11 content insight dimensions. Given a topic, it generates complete articles, 5 alternative titles with strategies, and AI image prompts. It adapts to WeChat, Xiaohongshu, and Douyin platforms with distinct styles, outputs structured Markdown, and enhances content depth and engagement through systematic thinking frameworks.

repos.description: How top iOS apps say hello | 10 animated welcome screens inspired by top-earning apps. Rebuilt in React Native + Expo.
repos.summary_zh: 开源 React Native Expo 项目，收录 10 个受 Duolingo、Strava 等热门 iOS 应用启发的动画欢迎/启动/引导屏幕。每个均为完整 TypeScript 组件，基于 Reanimated 实现精准时间轴动画、响应式缩放、无障碍与减动画支持。开发者可直接运行画廊、复制组件或粘贴 AI 提示词快速集成，专为学习高端移动端 onboarding 设计而打造。
repos.summary_en: Open-source React Native Expo kit with 10 animated welcome, splash and onboarding screens inspired by top iOS apps like Duolingo and Strava. Each is a full TypeScript component powered by Reanimated, featuring authored timelines, responsive scaling, reduced-motion and accessibility support. Run the gallery, copy any component or paste AI prompts to integrate polished mobile onboarding UI for study or production use.

repos.description: 万物皆可搭节点 | Everything can be a proxy node
repos.summary_zh: one-node 是一个极简化的网络代理节点部署工具，核心理念是'万物皆可搭节点'。它允许将任意设备快速转换为功能完整的代理服务器，支持多种协议和平台。通过轻量级架构设计，实现一键部署和灵活配置，适用于个人隐私保护、企业内网访问、网络加速等场景，大幅降低代理节点搭建的技术门槛和运维成本。
repos.summary_en: one-node is a minimalist network proxy node deployment tool embodying the philosophy 'Everything can be a proxy node'. It enables rapid conversion of any device into a fully functional proxy server, supporting multiple protocols and platforms. With its lightweight architecture, it offers one-click deployment and flexible configuration for scenarios including personal privacy protection, corporate intranet access, and network acceleration, significantly reducing technical barriers and operational costs.

repos.description: LinPad — Linux for iPad. A real Linux desktop on the iPad: native windowed desktop with tiling and workspaces, real Linux apps (Firefox, VS Code, Thunar, VLC) as native windows, ARM64 JIT, GPU via Venus/Metal, keyboard + trackpad + touch.
repos.summary_zh: LinPad 将 iPad 变身真实 Linux 桌面，基于 Alpine Linux 与 Wayland 合成器，原生运行 VS Code、Firefox、VLC 等应用，支持窗口平铺、工作区、ARM64 JIT 及 Venus/Metal GPU 加速，无需虚拟机或越狱，一个应用解锁 iPad 完整生产力。
repos.summary_en: LinPad transforms iPad into a real Linux desktop powered by Alpine Linux and Wayland, running native apps like VS Code, Firefox, and VLC with window tiling, workspaces, ARM64 JIT, and Venus/Metal GPU acceleration—no VM or jailbreak needed.

repos.description: Markdown editor that gets out of your way. Lightweight, fast, portable. First release of https://4worlds.dev
repos.summary_zh: Inkwell是基于Rust+Tauri v2构建的轻量级Markdown编辑器，主打离线运行与极速启动（<1秒）。支持Mermaid图表、LaTeX公式、GitHub Flavored Markdown，提供4种主题与专注模式。100%本地存储，零遥测，安装包仅5-12MB。适用于跨平台写作，免费版功能完整，Pro版解锁PDF/HTML导出。
repos.summary_en: Inkwell is a sovereign Markdown editor built with Rust+Tauri v2, delivering <1s startup and offline-first operation. Features Mermaid diagrams, LaTeX math, GitHub Flavored Markdown, 4 themes, focus mode, and version history. 100% local storage, zero telemetry, 5-12MB footprint. Cross-platform for distraction-free writing. Free forever, Pro adds PDF/HTML export.

repos.description: A modern personal time management and task tracking application
repos.summary_zh: Fates 是一款基于 Tauri 和 Svelte 构建的开源时间管理与任务追踪应用。它通过可视化时间轴、热力图和数据分析帮助用户识别时间黑洞，内置 AI 助手可优化任务描述并自动生成周报。采用本地优先存储策略保障隐私，支持多端同步，旨在解决职场人士时间管理混乱、工作效率低下及周报总结困难等痛点。
repos.summary_en: Fates is a modern open-source time management and task tracking application built with Tauri and Svelte, designed to help professionals combat productivity challenges. It features visual timeline views, GitHub-style calendar heatmaps, and comprehensive data analytics to reveal time consumption patterns. The integrated AI assistant optimizes task descriptions, auto-generates weekly reports, and provides intelligent scheduling suggestions. Employing a local-first storage architecture for privacy protection, it supports seamless synchronization across web and desktop platforms. Fates directly addresses common pain points: disorganized time management, inefficient workflows, and the tedious process of weekly reporting, making it an ideal tool for self-improvement and career development.
